_comment: Substituent constants for electrophilic aromatic substitution (src/pka_structure.rs `ring_sigma_plus`, read by the reaction templates' `hammett` modifiers): [sigma_meta, sigma_para_plus] (Brown-Okamoto sigma+, electrophilic substituent constants, which include the resonance stabilisation of the arenium ion that sigma_para lacks). An ortho substituent counts with its sigma_para_plus; its steric hindrance is a separate per-substituent cost on the activation energy (`ortho_steric_kj`). A substituent group not listed here makes the ring unassessable (no rate is proposed). `aza` is a ring nitrogen seen from the attacked position (a pyridine-type ring is strongly deactivated). Constants are recalled from the literature (Brown & Okamoto, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 80 (1958) 4979; Hansch, Leo & Taft, Chem. Rev. 91 (1991) 165), tier Estimated, group names as in `data/pka_structure.json`.
